name: Wix

Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Very Heavy — an on-site, multi-hour LeetCode marathon (often 5 problems spanning easy to hard, 2-3 hours, on a Codility-like platform) is the primary filter, followed by a 90-minute system-design-and-implementation interview
rounds: Online/Zoom informational event for some pipelines (introducing company groups and the process)
On-site coding exam: 5 LeetCode-style problems (one easy, two medium, two hard reported in one loop) in about 2-3 hours on a proctored platform

A 90-minute technical interview with 2 engineers: a multi-part system-design-and-implementation question (e.g. building functions for URL routing rules: perfect match, prefix match, best-route finding)
extraTopics: Sustained performance across a genuinely long, hard on-site coding exam — 5 problems including 2 hard ones in one sitting is a heavier bar than most companies in this batch
Multi-part system design that blends design AND actual implementation, not just a whiteboard discussion
Software Engineer.notes: The full process is reported as notably long and slow, with 6-9 day waits between phases and an overall timeline that can exceed a month.

ladder.title: Student Software Engineer, Junior Software Engineer

rolesNotes: Only two detailed reports were reviewed, both from Wix’s Tel Aviv office, but they independently agree on the distinctive long, hard on-site coding exam — a genuinely unusual format worth flagging even with limited sourcing.
